keyEvents.text: Delay in match (Santos).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Lucas Veríssimo (Santos) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! São Paulo 1, Santos 0. Luciano (São Paulo) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Goal! São Paulo 1, Santos 1. Gabriel Barbosa (Santos) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Gonzalo Escobar with a cross.
Luciano (São Paulo) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Iago Borduchi (São Paulo).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Christian Oliva (Santos) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, São Paulo 1, Santos 1.
Substitution, Santos. Philippe Coutinho replaces Álvaro Barreal.
Substitution, Santos. Gustavo Henrique replaces Lima.
Delay in match because of an injury Arthur (Santos).
Substitution, Santos. Gabriel Menino replaces Arthur because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! São Paulo 1, Santos 2. Gabriel Barbosa (Santos) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Everton.
Substitution, São Paulo. Gustavo Santana replaces Ryan Francisco.
Substitution, São Paulo. Danielzinho replaces Damián Bobadilla.
Substitution, São Paulo. Newton replaces Rafael Tolói.
Substitution, São Paulo. Wendell replaces Iago Borduchi.
Substitution, São Paulo. Victor Sá replaces Pedro Lima.
Everton (Santos) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Santos. Rony replaces Everton.
Substitution, Santos. Thaciano replaces Gabriel Barbosa.
